title: NATS message envelope
description: Every message on CMD / EVT / evt.auth.*. `data` is per type (messages/<type>.schema.json). The envelope is closed: a new envelope field is a breaking change. `data` is open: consumers ignore unknown fields (additive changes keep the version).

type.description: message type, e.g. cmd.run.execute; never the routing subject (cmd.run.execute travels on cmd.run.<host>.<env>, evt.run.status on evt.run.<session_id>.status)

version.description: major version of this type's data schema

id.description: message id (unique per message; dedupe uses Nats-Msg-Id, see contracts/README.md)

job_id.description: the command's job: the run id for cmd.run.*, evt.run.* and evt.studio.run_finished, the batch id for cmd.pipeline.* and evt.pipeline.* (Nats-Msg-Id <job_id>:<attempt> for commands, <job_id>:<seq> for events); null only for non-job messages (evt.auth.revoked)

owner_id.description: the user who owns the session / token; every object key in data is under u/<owner_id>/
